summary: Converts floating-point vertex color data to 8-bit RGB bytes. Optionally runs DirectXVertexBufferFormatConversion when the format flag at this+0x1048 is set, computes a source base from this+0x2C and the packed (a2,a3) indices, calls UtilityFunction_7473, then for each of this+0x1058 vertices scales three floats by 255.0 and writes consecutive R,G,B bytes. Returns the conversion-state global dword_8B009C.

operations.description: If this[1042] (this+0x1048) is non-zero, convert the vertex buffer format before processing.
Call DirectXVertexBufferFormatConversion(this, a4) and replace a4 with the converted format.
Compute the source base v5 = this[11] (this+0x2C) + 4 * ((a3 & 3) + 8 * (a2 & 3)).
Unconditional call to UtilityFunction_7473 before the conversion loop.

For each of this[1046] (this+0x1058) vertices, read three floats from the source quad (indexed by i & 3), add the base offset, scale by 255.0, and write consecutive R,G,B bytes to the output stream; advance the source cursor 16 bytes per quad and the output cursor 3 bytes per vertex.
